column6: In seconds is the promise; the fear being addressed is how long choosing glasses normally takes.
Google and Samsung logos under the brand; the co-sign is what makes a new category safe to consider.
Sunglasses on a golf course; the sport supplies the context that makes the frames read as equipment.
A necessary accessory and a name; the frame is being introduced like a character.
Twenty percent off additional pairs; she already owns one, and the ad is only arguing about the second.
We're here, Rochester names a city; the ad is a shop opening dressed as a product post.
One pair on white; at this point in the funnel he is comparing shapes, not brands.
A patterned metal plate on white; the finish is the only thing distinguishing it from the last tile.
The old wallets laid out below the new one; the comparison is the argument and the bulk is the villain.
A ring on white under the same wordmark; the brand is extending into what he already wears.
Six years running and two winners; past winners' faces are the proof the prize is real.
Ten percent lighter and a lifetime warranty; he owns the first version and is being sold the delta.
Supercars lit in a warehouse; the wallet is not in frame because the wallet is not the offer.
The same cars again; the giveaway is the whole media buy and the product is the entry mechanic.
A team mark on a wallet; the licence is the reason to replace something that still works.

column2: The Man Watching Another Man's Routine
column6: A face he already trusts on reviews; the endorsement borrows a whole channel's credibility.
A ring turning in macro; the finish is the only differentiator and it has to be seen moving.
Customize your carry over a licensed print; the wallet is a surface for something else he likes.
Now at a mass retailer; the ad exists to move the purchase from a website to a trip she was already taking.
Final few and seventy-five percent off; the discount is deep enough that the product barely appears.
